A spherical die

A die can be constructed in the shape of a sphere, with the addition of an internal cavity in the shape of the [dual polyhedron](/wiki/Dual_polyhedron "Dual polyhedron") of the desired die shape and an internal weight. The weight settles into one of the points of the internal cavity, causing it to settle with one of the numbers uppermost. For instance, a sphere with an octahedral cavity and a small internal weight settles with one of the 6 points of the cavity held downward by the weight.

The [1980s](/wiki/1980s "1980s") also marked the G7's expanded concerns beyond macroeconomic issues, namely with respect to [international security](/wiki/International_security "International security") and conflict; for example, it sought to address the ongoing [conflicts between Iran and Iraq](/wiki/Iran%E2%80%93Iraq_War "Iran–Iraq War") and between the Soviet Union and Afghanistan ([Afghan conflict](/wiki/Afghan_conflict "Afghan conflict")).

**Kenan Thompson** ([/kiːnən/](/wiki/Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); born May 10, 1978)[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an American actor and comedian. He has been a cast member on the [NBC](/wiki/NBC "NBC") [sketch comedy](/wiki/Sketch_comedy "Sketch comedy") series *[Saturday Night Live](/wiki/Saturday_Night_Live "Saturday Night Live")* since [2003](/wiki/Saturday_Night_Live_season_29 "Saturday Night Live season 29"), making him the longest-tenured cast member in the show's history.[[2]](#cite_note-Izadi_2019-2) He was also the first regular cast member born after the show's premiere in 1975. Outside of *SNL*, Thompson starred on NBC's sitcom *[Kenan](/wiki/Kenan_(TV_series) "Kenan (TV series)")* from 2021 to 2022.

Thompson began his acting career in the early 1990s, and was an original cast member of [Nickelodeon](/wiki/Nickelodeon "Nickelodeon")'s sketch comedy series *[All That](/wiki/All_That "All That")* (1994–2005), where he often collaborated with co-star [Kel Mitchell](/wiki/Kel_Mitchell "Kel Mitchell"). Beginning in 1996, they starred in their own [sitcom](/wiki/Sitcom "Sitcom") *[Kenan & Kel](/wiki/Kenan_%26_Kel "Kenan & Kel")* (1996–2000). Thompson also had roles in *[The Mighty Ducks](/wiki/The_Mighty_Ducks_(film_series) "The Mighty Ducks (film series)")* franchise, *[Good Burger](/wiki/Good_Burger "Good Burger")* and its sequel *[Good Burger 2](/wiki/Good_Burger_2 "Good Burger 2")*, and as the title character in the 2004 film *[Fat Albert](/wiki/Fat_Albert_(film) "Fat Albert (film)")*.
